crossRefs.note: Of the sons of Zerah: Jeuel and their brothers, six hundred ninety.
Judah became the father of Perez and Zerah by Tamar. Perez became the father of Hezron. Hezron became the father of Ram.

people.name: Zerah
people.line: Son of Judah, twin of Perez

translations.web: Afterward his brother came out, who had the scarlet thread on his hand, and his name was called Zerah.
translations.bsb: Then his brother came out with the scarlet thread around his wrist, and he was named Zerah.
translations.kjv: And afterward came out his brother, that had the scarlet thread upon his hand: and his name was called Zarah.
translations.asv: And afterward came out his brother, that had the scarlet thread upon his hand: and his name was called Zerah.
